newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firmer, Dutch holiday quells trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firmer, Dutch holiday quells trade.

text.p: NWE oil products were generally stronger on Wednesday on the back of futures, traders said.
They noted, however, that markets were subdued because of the Netherlands' Queen's Day public holiday.
Gas oil strengthened on gains in IPE futures. The May gas oil contract was $1.25 higher at $170.00 a tonne at 0837 GMT.
Gasoline was also stronger with Eurograde barges quoted at $198/$198.50 a tonne. Traders attributed the gains to NYMEX unleaded's positive performance on Tuesday.
The May contract ended 1.02 cents higher at 63.36 cents a gallon on Tuesday and was 0.04 cents higher in ACCESS trading.
The high sulphur fuel oil market was extremely quiet. Barges were quoted around the $80/$83 a tonne level.
